headline: God of War: Kratos' first revenge
title: God of War 2005 Facts | Kratos Origin | Classic Games
video_script: God of War arrived on PlayStation two on March twenty second, two thousand five, from Santa Monica Studio. You play Kratos, a Spartan warrior sent by the goddess Athena to kill Ares, the God of War. Combat centers on the Blades of Chaos, and big enemies are finished with quick time events. It sold over four point six million copies by twenty twelve and started a series with eight more games. Favorite Kratos weapon? Comment below!
description: God of War (Santa Monica Studio, March 22, 2005, PS2): Kratos hunts Ares with the Blades of Chaos; over 4.6 million sold by June 2012. Source: Wikipedia.
